If one of the times above works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and an agenda. If none work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

4) Procurement / terms Q&A (10–15 min) — Lauren to join for SLAs/credits discussion if needed
5) Next steps & MAP owners + dates (5 min)
